summary.text: TEST: my landlord gave me a 3-day notice
summary.label: user_reported

documents_to_gather.document: Every notice or court paper you received, with the envelope or the date you got it
Rent receipts or bank records of payments
Photos of the unit's condition, if relevant
Messages with the landlord or manager

consultation_questions: Do you represent tenants? Do you have any conflict with my landlord?
What do you charge for a first consultation, and how are fees set after that?
What should I bring, and what should I avoid doing before we meet?
If there is a court date, can you help in time, or who could?

checklist.label: The state where the matter is
checklist.why: Lawyers are licensed state by state.

checklist.label: The kind of legal matter, in your words
checklist.why: Lets the office tell quickly whether it handles this kind of matter.

checklist.label: Which side you are on (for example tenant or landlord)
checklist.why: Offices check this before they can talk with you.

checklist.label: The name of the other side (person or company)
checklist.why: Offices need it for their conflicts check before a consultation. It is shared only if you tick it.

checklist.label: Important dates you were told about (court dates, notices)
checklist.why: Shown as you reported them. The host does not check or calculate deadlines.

checklist.label: What you want to happen
checklist.why: Helps the lawyer plan the first meeting.

checklist.label: The kind of notice you received, if any (for example 3-day notice, unlawful detainer papers)
checklist.why: Different papers have different next steps.

checklist.label: Whether rent is paid up, in your words
checklist.why: Often asked at the first meeting.

readiness.definition: How many checklist items you have answered. It is NOT a prediction of whether you have a case, will win, or will be accepted by a lawyer.

export.note: Download or copy this to reuse it with any lawyer or app. Nothing is shared until you approve one named recipient and the exact fields.

rules: The host does not give legal advice, does not judge whether you have a case, and does not certify anything a lawyer says about themselves.
An inquiry or consultation request alone does not create an attorney-client relationship.
Do not upload documents here. Bring copies to the consultation, or share them later through the office's own secure system if it asks.
